chunks: At the still centre in the proximity of the King all-powerful.
ai.seo_question: What does 'Maqdad Sidq' mean in the context of Paradise?
ai.summary: This phrase, often cited in Shia exegesis as a description of the Prophet Muhammad's station in Jannah, highlights the concept of 'Miqdad' (proximity) not merely as physical nearness but as spiritual closeness to the Divine Will. It underscores the ultimate reward for the righteous, where they dwell in a 'place of truth' (Miqdad Sidq) under the direct authority of the All-Powerful King, reflecting the culmination of their spiritual journey.
